input: Compare two internal offers. Quick Start: audience is new staff; promise is "Complete account setup in one guided session"; assets are a setup checklist and a 30-minute session; proof is a dated internal walkthrough showing completion of the checklist, source: Operations, 2026-11-01; friction is booking the session; constraint is new staff only. Reference Pack: audience is all staff; promise is "Answer common setup questions"; asset is an FAQ; no proof item is supplied; friction is self-service reading; no constraints supplied. Question: distinguish delivery format and supplied proof. Known unknown: FAQ coverage has not been reviewed.

offers.name: Quick Start
offers.promise: Complete account setup in one guided session

proof_items.item: Internal walkthrough showing completion of the checklist

unresolved_items: The supplied proof covers checklist completion but does not establish complete account setup or the one-session condition.

offers.name: Reference Pack
unresolved_items: FAQ coverage has not been reviewed

supplied_contrasts: Quick Start is guided and restricted to new staff; Reference Pack is self-service and intended for all staff.
evidence_gaps: Quick Start proof does not cover complete account setup or the one-session condition; Reference Pack has no supplied proof and its FAQ coverage has not been reviewed.

outside_scope: Selecting a winner, estimating demand, and recommending pricing are outside this comparison.
